mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.5% signals a weak labor market and deteriorating corporate earnings prospects, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 9.5%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 50th percentile, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases

mechanism_narrative: A low industrial production index below 95 signals a weakening supply chain and economic contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 95, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate exceeding 600,000 units signals a strong housing market and robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 600, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong retail sales (RSAFS > 370,000), consumer spending growth supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS exceeds 370, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases
